role: Display-time translator for the Help Center: looks each English Help string up by its exact English text in the separate 'Help' string table of the app-language bundle, with a {token} template formatter and a test-only key recorder; plus `localized` projections for HelpCategory/HelpArticle/ArticleSection.
state: mem:HelpLocalization.formattedMark U+2060 word joiner marking already-translated strings (HelpLocalization.swift:39)
mem:HelpLocalization.recorder OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Set<String>?> — nil in the app, a set while a test records lookups (HelpLocalization.swift:43)
toplevel: Static let initialisers: table name 'Help', formattedMark U+2060, recorder lock initialised to nil (recording off).

flags.text: format() output carries an invisible leading U+2060 that is stripped only when the string later passes through HelpLocalization.string (the `localized` pass). HelpContent.englishCategories(forAge:) with a non-nil age returns un-localized categories whose age-personalised strings still start with U+2060; today only tests call englishCategories and always with age nil, so the mark is never exposed, but any future non-localized consumer with an age would show/search strings with a hidden character.

units.does: Translates one English Help string: if it starts with the U+2060 mark (already translated by format) returns it with the mark dropped; otherwise records the key when a test has recording on, then returns LanguageManager.appBundle.localizedString(forKey: english, value: english, table: 'Help'), i.e. the English itself when the table lacks the key.

branches.cond: first character is the U+2060 formattedMark
branches.effect: returns the rest of the string untranslated and does not record it; otherwise records (if recording) and looks the key up, falling back to the English

units.does: Translates an English {token} template via string(), substitutes each values entry for '{key}', and prefixes U+2060 so the later localized pass passes it through untouched.
Turns key recording on by setting the recorder lock's state to an empty set.
Returns the set of recorded Help lookup keys and turns recording off (sets state back to nil).

branches.cond: keys ?? [] — recorder state is nil (recording was never started)
branches.effect: returns an empty set; otherwise returns the recorded set

units.does: Returns a copy of the category with title translated via HelpLocalization.string and every article mapped through HelpArticle.localized; id, icon and color unchanged.
Returns a copy of the article with title and summary translated via HelpLocalization.string and every section mapped through ArticleSection.localized.
Returns the section with every user-visible string passed through HelpLocalization.string (labels and values of keyValue pairs both translated); divider returned unchanged.

branches.effect: returns .keyValue with label and value of each pair translated
